summary: Quantum Cyber N.V., a Nasdaq-listed Dutch pharmaceutical company (QUCY), filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on October 9, 2026 to establish an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $100,000,000 in ordinary shares through Titan Partners Securities LLC as sales agent. Shares may be sold on Nasdaq at market prices; the stock closed at $1.39 on October 8, 2026. The agent receives a 3% commission with no escrow. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch share-price overhang and dilution from potential sales.
